sentences.en: In 2011, the body of a woman was discovered in a California vineyard.
sentences.zh: 2011年，一名女子的尸体在加利福尼亚州的一个葡萄园中被发现。

sentences.en: She had been decapitated, and her body had been drained of blood.
sentences.zh: 她遭到了斩首，体内的血液已被排干。

sentences.en: It appeared her killer had gone to extraordinary lengths to conceal her identity.
sentences.zh: 凶手似乎费尽心机想要隐瞒她的身份。

sentences.en: For more than a decade, she was known only as Jane Doe.
sentences.zh: 十多年来，她只被称为“无名氏”。

sentences.en: Then, detectives finally learned her name, Ada.
sentences.zh: 后来，侦探们终于查明了她的名字：艾达。

sentences.en: But identifying her only made this bizarre murder even more perplexing.
sentences.zh: 但确认她的身份反而让这起离奇的谋杀案变得更加扑朔迷离。

sentences.en: Ada is the new series from Casefile Presents, available now wherever you get your podcasts.
sentences.zh: 《艾达》是“案件档案呈现”系列的新作，现已在各大播客平台上线。

sentences.en: When the winning numbers of the Florida Lottery were announced on Wednesday, October 25, 2006, the $3 million jackpot went unclaimed.
sentences.zh: 2006年10月25日星期三，佛罗里达州彩票开奖，300万美元的头奖无人认领。

sentences.en: This wasn't unusual.
sentences.zh: 这并不罕见。

sentences.en: The odds of picking the six lucky numbers from a possible 69 was one in over 292 million.
sentences.zh: 从69个数字中选出6个幸运数字的概率是2.92亿分之一。

sentences.en: With no claimants, the Florida Lottery jackpot rolled over.
sentences.zh: 由于无人认领，佛罗里达州彩票的头奖奖金进行了滚存。

sentences.en: Meaning it was added to the grand prize of the next draw.
sentences.zh: 这意味着这笔钱被加到了下一期的奖金池中。

sentences.en: Once again, nobody won.
sentences.zh: 结果还是没人中奖。

sentences.en: Over the following two weeks, the jackpot rolled over three more times.
sentences.zh: 在接下来的两周里，头奖又连续滚存了三次。

sentences.en: By Wednesday, November 15, 2006, it had reached $30 million.
sentences.zh: 到2006年11月15日星期三，奖金已达到3000万美元。

sentences.en: 41-year-old Abraham Shakespeare lived in the Florida city of Lakeland.
sentences.zh: 41岁的亚伯拉罕·莎士比亚住在佛罗里达州的莱克兰市。

sentences.en: The small home he shared with his mother was in the same underprivileged neighbourhood where Abraham had spent most of his life.
sentences.zh: 他与母亲合住的小房子位于他生活了大半辈子的贫困社区。

sentences.en: Despite experiencing poverty, homelessness, discrimination and run-ins with the law, Abraham remained good-natured and easygoing.
sentences.zh: 尽管经历过贫困、无家可归、歧视和法律纠纷，亚伯拉罕依然性格随和、心地善良。

sentences.en: Even though he mostly kept to himself, he was a familiar and well-liked figure in his community.
sentences.zh: 虽然他平时不太与人来往，但在社区里却是个熟面孔，大家都挺喜欢他。

sentences.en: Abraham had no bank account, credit card or savings.
sentences.zh: 亚伯拉罕没有银行账户、信用卡或存款。

sentences.en: Dropping out of school in the seventh grade had left him with few skills or opportunities.
sentences.zh: 他七年级就辍学了，几乎没什么技能或就业机会。

sentences.en: He was in a labour pool, a network of independent workers that could be hired on an as-needed basis for various jobs.
sentences.zh: 他属于一个劳务派遣群体，这是一个由独立工人组成的网络，可以根据需要被雇佣去从事各种工作。

sentences.en: The tall and slender African-American took on any work available, from washing dishes and sweeping floors to collecting trash and loading trucks.
sentences.zh: 这位身材高瘦的非裔美国人什么活都干，从洗碗、扫地到收垃圾、装货车，来者不拒。

sentences.en: Although he spent most of his time working, Abraham Shakespeare constantly scraped the bread line.
sentences.zh: 尽管大部分时间都在工作，亚伯拉罕·莎士比亚依然在温饱线上挣扎。

sentences.en: In 2006, he was earning just $8 an hour as a truck driver's assistant for a food distribution company.
sentences.zh: 2006年，他作为一家食品配送公司的货车司机助理，时薪仅为8美元。

sentences.en: Despite his best efforts, he'd fallen behind on paying child support for his five-year-old son.
sentences.zh: 尽管他尽了最大努力，还是拖欠了五岁儿子的抚养费。

sentences.en: In his rare moments of respite, Abraham would walk around Lake Hollingsworth in the city centre.
sentences.zh: 在难得的休息时间里，亚伯拉罕会绕着市中心的霍林斯沃思湖散步。

sentences.en: He'd imagine owning one of the expensive houses that overlooked the water, only to reflect on his current circumstances with disappointment.
sentences.zh: 他会幻想自己拥有那些俯瞰湖面的豪宅，但随后又会失望地面对自己的现状。

sentences.en: On Wednesday, November 15, 2006, Abraham and a colleague named Michael Ford set out on a 230-mile route to deliver meat to fast-food restaurants.
sentences.zh: 2006年11月15日星期三，亚伯拉罕和同事迈克尔·福特踏上了230英里的路程，去给快餐店送肉。

sentences.en: Not long after leaving Lakeland, the pair stopped at a convenience store in the city of Frostproof.
sentences.zh: 离开莱克兰不久，两人在弗罗斯特普鲁夫市的一家便利店停了下来。

sentences.en: Michael headed inside to buy drinks and cigarettes, asking Abraham if he wanted a soda.
sentences.zh: 迈克尔进去买饮料和香烟，问亚伯拉罕要不要喝汽水。

sentences.en: Abraham instead told Michael to, quote,
sentences.zh: 亚伯拉罕却对迈克尔说，引用他的话：

sentences.en: Quick picks are a type of lottery ticket.
sentences.zh: “机选”是一种彩票类型。

sentences.en: The player's six numbers are randomly generated in the lottery terminal and added to their coupon.
sentences.zh: 玩家的六个数字由彩票终端随机生成，并添加到他们的彩票上。

sentences.en: Compared to the more traditional method where a player personally selects each number, it's a fast and easy way to play the lottery.
sentences.zh: 与玩家亲自挑选每个数字的传统方式相比，这是一种快速简便的购彩方式。

sentences.en: Michael Ford purchased two quick picks for Abraham, and Abraham paid him two of the five dollars he currently had to his name.
sentences.zh: 迈克尔·福特为亚伯拉罕买了两张机选彩票，亚伯拉罕付给他五美元中的两美元。

sentences.en: He gave the remaining three dollars to a homeless man.
sentences.zh: 他把剩下的三美元给了路边的一名流浪汉。

sentences.en: The Florida lotto was drawn that night.
sentences.zh: 佛罗里达彩票当晚开奖。

sentences.en: The numbers announced were six, twelve, thirteen, thirty-four, forty-two, and fifty-two.
Abraham Shakespeare was stunned.
sentences.zh: 亚伯拉罕·莎士比亚惊呆了。

sentences.en: Abraham appeared on television to celebrate his massive lottery win.
sentences.zh: 亚伯拉罕出现在电视上庆祝他赢得巨额彩票。

sentences.en: He was his typical laid-back self, dressed in baggy pants and a white t-shirt with his dreadlocks tucked under his cap.
sentences.zh: 他依然是一贯的随性打扮，穿着宽松的裤子和白色T恤，脏辫塞在帽子里。

sentences.en: Abraham was handed an oversized novelty check with thirty million printed on it in large, bold lettering.
sentences.zh: 亚伯拉罕接过一张巨大的支票，上面用醒目的粗体字印着“三千万”。

sentences.en: Abraham had two options.
sentences.zh: 亚伯拉罕有两个选择。

sentences.en: Receive the prize money in annual increments of one and a half million dollars over twenty years, or take an immediate lump sum minus twenty-five percent in taxes.
sentences.zh: 要么在二十年内每年领取150万美元的奖金，要么一次性领取扣除25%税款后的现金。

sentences.en: Abraham chose the second option, as most lottery winners do, and walked away with seventeen million dollars.
sentences.zh: 亚伯拉罕像大多数彩票中奖者一样选择了后者，最终拿到了1700万美元。

sentences.en: For Abraham, who'd only ever known poverty, that was more than enough.
sentences.zh: 对于只经历过贫困的亚伯拉罕来说，这已经绰绰有余了。

sentences.en: As he collected his winnings, he announced, I don't have to struggle no more.
sentences.zh: 在领取奖金时，他宣布：“我再也不用受苦了。”

sentences.en: Abraham immediately used his newfound wealth to resolve several debts, including the child support he owed.
sentences.zh: 亚伯拉罕立即用这笔新财富偿还了多笔债务，包括他拖欠的抚养费。

sentences.en: He also set up a million-dollar trust for his son.
sentences.zh: 他还为儿子设立了一个百万美元的信托基金。

sentences.en: Although lottery winners are advised to seek the services of a financial advisor, Abraham didn't believe he needed one, saying, I don't let material things run me.
sentences.zh: 虽然有人建议彩票中奖者寻求财务顾问的服务，但亚伯拉罕认为自己不需要，他说：“我不会让物质支配我。”

sentences.en: I'm on a tight budget.
sentences.zh: “我生活很节俭。”

sentences.en: Despite being a multi-millionaire, Abraham continued to eat at his local Denny's diner, pick up pennies off the ground, and spend his days hanging out in his old neighbourhood.
sentences.zh: 尽管已是千万富翁，亚伯拉罕依然去当地的丹尼餐厅吃饭，捡地上的硬币，每天在老社区里闲逛。

sentences.en: Abraham offered to buy his mother a new home, but she respectfully declined, so he paid off her existing house instead.
sentences.zh: 亚伯拉罕提出要给母亲买套新房，但被她婉言谢绝了，于是他帮她还清了现有房子的贷款。

sentences.en: He then established several philanthropic enterprises that centred on assisting those in need.
sentences.zh: 随后，他建立了几家旨在帮助贫困群体的慈善机构。

sentences.en: Abraham rewarded himself with just a few splurges, including a new car, some clothes, and a Rolex watch that he bought at a discount from a pawn shop.
sentences.zh: 亚伯拉罕只奖励了自己几样东西，包括一辆新车、一些衣服，以及一块从当铺打折买来的劳力士手表。

sentences.en: His biggest indulgence was a million-dollar home north of the city in an upscale, gated community on Redhawk Bend Drive.
sentences.zh: 他最大的奢侈消费是城北一个高档封闭式社区——红鹰弯道的一栋百万美元豪宅。

sentences.en: The spacious, two-storey residence had four bedrooms and four bathrooMs.
sentences.zh: 这栋宽敞的两层住宅有四间卧室和四间浴室。

sentences.en: It featured stainless steel appliances, granite counters, walk-in closets, fireplaces, a guest suite, and a double garage.
sentences.zh: 配备了不锈钢家电、花岗岩台面、步入式衣橱、壁炉、客房套间和双车位车库。

sentences.en: French doors opened out to a private deck with a swimming pool and spa.
sentences.zh: 法式门通向一个带有游泳池和水疗中心的私人露台。

sentences.en: It was exactly the type of home Abraham had dreamed of owning.
sentences.zh: 这正是亚伯拉罕梦寐以求的房子。

sentences.en: Although Abraham's money didn't change him much, it changed everyone around him.
sentences.zh: 虽然钱并没有改变亚伯拉罕多少，但它改变了他周围的所有人。

sentences.en: As soon as news of his big win got out, friends and strangers alike began approaching him with stories of financial hardship.
sentences.zh: 他中大奖的消息一传开，朋友和陌生人就开始带着各种经济困难的故事找上门来。

sentences.en: Described as a soft touch, who thought with his heart, Abraham willingly helped them pay everything from bills to medical treatments and business start-ups.
sentences.zh: 亚伯拉罕被形容为“心肠软”，他总是凭感情行事，乐于帮人支付账单、医疗费甚至创业资金。

sentences.en: He lost count of how many people he helped, saying,
sentences.zh: 他记不清自己帮过多少人，他说：

sentences.en: The Bible states it's better to give than to receive.
sentences.zh: “圣经说，施比受更有福。”

sentences.en: In Abraham's eyes, most of these handouts were loans rather than gifts.
sentences.zh: 在亚伯拉罕看来，这些钱大多是借款，而不是赠予。

sentences.en: Yet no one ever made any effort to pay him back.
sentences.zh: 然而，从来没有人试图还钱给他。

sentences.en: Questions about when Abraham's generosity would be repaid were met with excuses and complaints.
sentences.zh: 当他问起什么时候能还钱时，得到的总是各种借口和抱怨。

sentences.en: Some people were upset to learn his money was given with strings attached.
sentences.zh: 有些人得知他的钱是有条件的，感到很不高兴。

sentences.en: Conflict also arose in Abraham's family over the amount he shared with them.
sentences.zh: 亚伯拉罕的家人也因为他给出的金额多少而产生了矛盾。

sentences.en: Rather than making him happy, Abraham said his lottery win had made him miserable.
sentences.zh: 亚伯拉罕说，中奖并没有让他快乐，反而让他感到痛苦。

sentences.en: People constantly stopped him in the street and his cell phone rang non-stop.
sentences.zh: 人们不断在街上拦住他，他的手机也响个不停。

sentences.en: During a 30-minute catch-up with his younger brother, Abraham fielded eight calls from people requesting cash.
sentences.zh: 在与弟弟通电话的30分钟里，亚伯拉罕接了八个找他要钱的电话。

sentences.en: He even received a letter from a prison inmate asking for $1,000.
sentences.zh: 他甚至收到了一名监狱囚犯寄来的信，向他索要1000美元。

sentences.en: While this request amused Abraham, he still sent the man $50.
sentences.zh: 虽然这个请求让亚伯拉罕觉得好笑，但他还是给那个人寄去了50美元。

sentences.en: Abraham's sister said he was too sweet-natured to say no to anybody.
sentences.zh: 亚伯拉罕的姐姐说，他性格太好，不懂得拒绝任何人。

sentences.en: And because of his limitless charity, Abraham never had any peace.
sentences.zh: 也正因为他无底线的慷慨，亚伯拉罕从未得到过安宁。

sentences.en: Both exasperated by his instant celebrity and demoralised by everyone's demands, he began sleeping all day and cruising the quiet streets of Lakeland at night.
sentences.zh: 由于对突如其来的名气感到厌烦，又对众人的索求感到沮丧，他开始白天睡觉，晚上在莱克兰安静的街道上开车兜风。

sentences.en: Abraham also escaped by travelling.
sentences.zh: 亚伯拉罕也通过旅行来逃避。

sentences.en: He went on a cruise to the Caribbean and took a few short trips to New York City, which he grew particularly fond of.
sentences.zh: 他去加勒比海游轮旅行，还去了几次纽约，并对那里产生了特别的好感。

sentences.en: He hoped the distance from his community would lessen the pressure, expectations and hostilities thrust upon him.
sentences.zh: 他希望远离社区能减轻施加在他身上的压力、期望和敌意。

sentences.en: Michael Ford was bitter towards his former colleague, Abraham Shakespeare.
sentences.zh: 迈克尔·福特对他的前同事亚伯拉罕·莎士比亚怀恨在心。

sentences.en: Michael frequently visited the frost-proof convenience store where the winning lottery ticket was purchased.
sentences.zh: 迈克尔经常光顾那家买到中奖彩票的弗罗斯特普鲁夫便利店。

sentences.en: Without fail, he always bought two QuickPix for himself.
sentences.zh: 他总是雷打不动地给自己买两张机选彩票。

sentences.en: Michael asserted that Wednesday, November 16, 2006 was no different.
sentences.zh: 迈克尔坚称2006年11月16日星期三那天也不例外。

sentences.en: Store records and CCTV footage confirmed that Michael had purchased two QuickPix that day.
sentences.zh: 商店记录和监控录像证实，迈克尔那天确实买了两张机选彩票。

sentences.en: Michael insisted that if he had purchased any for Abraham Shakespeare, then he would have had four tickets in total.
sentences.zh: 迈克尔坚持说，如果他当时帮亚伯拉罕·莎士比亚买了，那他总共应该有四张票。

sentences.en: According to Michael, he tucked the tickets into his wallet, which he kept in an overhead compartment inside his truck.
sentences.zh: 据迈克尔说，他把彩票塞进了钱包，放在货车顶部的储物格里。

sentences.en: Michael said he realised his lottery tickets were missing the following day.
sentences.zh: 迈克尔说，第二天他发现彩票不见了。

sentences.en: He assumed that he'd lost them until a supervisor informed him that Abraham won the jackpot.
sentences.zh: 他以为自己弄丢了，直到主管告诉他亚伯拉罕中了头奖。

sentences.en: Michael confronted Abraham and accused him of stealing the tickets while he'd been left alone in the truck.
sentences.zh: 迈克尔找到亚伯拉罕，指责他在货车里独处时偷走了彩票。

sentences.en: Abraham allegedly admitted to swiping the tickets from Michael's wallet and was confident that no one could prove it.
sentences.zh: 据称亚伯拉罕承认从迈克尔的钱包里顺走了彩票，并确信没人能证明这一点。

sentences.en: Michael said Abraham had offered him a million dollars to put the matter to rest, but he'd decided to file a lawsuit against Abraham instead.
sentences.zh: 迈克尔说亚伯拉罕曾提出给他一百万美元了结此事，但他决定起诉亚伯拉罕。

sentences.en: Abraham flatly denied these allegations, saying,
sentences.zh: 亚伯拉罕断然否认了这些指控，他说：

sentences.en: According to Abraham, after his win, Michael asked Abraham to look out for him by giving him a million dollars so he could move interstate and start a business.
sentences.zh: 据亚伯拉罕说，中奖后，迈克尔请求他关照一下，给他一百万美元，好让他搬到外州创业。

sentences.en: Abraham was willing to help, but lottery officials hadn't wired him the money yet, so he told Michael to be patient.
sentences.zh: 亚伯拉罕愿意帮忙，但彩票中心还没把钱汇给他，所以他让迈克尔耐心等待。

sentences.en: He also offered a smaller amount as he felt a million dollars was excessive.
sentences.zh: 他也提出给一个较小的金额，因为他觉得一百万美元太多了。

sentences.en: Michael confronted Abraham again two days later, this time indicating his intention to sue.
sentences.zh: 两天后，迈克尔再次找到亚伯拉罕，这次表示要起诉他。

sentences.en: Abraham explained,
sentences.zh: 亚伯拉罕解释道：

sentences.en: By the time Michael came for Abraham's prize money, there was 12 million dollars left.
sentences.zh: 当迈克尔来索要奖金时，亚伯拉罕还剩下1200万美元。

sentences.en: Michael sought injunctive relief which would immediately freeze Abraham's assets and prevent him from spending any more of the winnings.
sentences.zh: 迈克尔寻求禁令救济，要求立即冻结亚伯拉罕的资产，防止他继续挥霍奖金。

sentences.en: A circuit court judge ruled in Michael's favour.
sentences.zh: 巡回法院法官做出了有利于迈克尔的裁决。

sentences.en: The matter went to court in October 2007, five months after Abraham's big win.
sentences.zh: 2007年10月，即亚伯拉罕中奖五个月后，此案开庭审理。

sentences.en: The dramatic proceedings became a public spectacle.
sentences.zh: 戏剧性的庭审过程成了公众瞩目的焦点。

sentences.en: Michael Ford's attorney worked to undermine Abraham's character by repeatedly bringing up his criminal paSt.
sentences.zh: 迈克尔·福特的律师通过反复提及亚伯拉罕的犯罪前科来诋毁他的人格。

sentences.en: At age 13, Abraham was caught stealing from a convenience store and sent to a state-run juvenile reform school.
sentences.zh: 13岁时，亚伯拉罕因在便利店偷窃被捕，并被送往州立少年管教所。

sentences.en: He remained there until he was 18, then proceeded to rack up a range of offences that included trespassing, assault, and theft.
sentences.zh: 他在那里待到18岁，随后又犯下了一系列罪行，包括非法入侵、袭击和盗窃。

sentences.en: As an adult, he amassed seven felony and three misdemeanor convictions, resulting in two stints in prison.
sentences.zh: 成年后，他有七项重罪和三项轻罪记录，并两次入狱。

sentences.en: When witnesses attested to Abraham's good character,
sentences.zh: 当证人为亚伯拉罕的良好品格作证时，

sentences.en: Michael's counsel accused Abraham of paying them off for their testimony.
sentences.zh: 迈克尔的律师指责亚伯拉罕花钱收买证人。

sentences.en: In turn, Abraham's attorney accused the plaintiff of piling dirt on his client, saying that bringing up his criminal record
sentences.zh: 反过来，亚伯拉罕的律师指责原告在往他当事人身上泼脏水，称提及他的犯罪记录

sentences.en: was an attempt to distract the jury from the pertinent issues.
sentences.zh: 是试图转移陪审团对核心问题的注意力。

sentences.en: They questioned why Abraham would steal the lottery tickets, which were worthless at the time the alleged theft occurred.
sentences.zh: 他们质疑亚伯拉罕为什么要偷彩票，因为在所谓的盗窃发生时，彩票一文不值。

sentences.en: Abraham had no way of knowing one would win the jackpot.
sentences.zh: 亚伯拉罕根本无法预知哪张彩票会中头奖。

sentences.en: Abraham also had an extensive history of playing the lottery.
sentences.zh: 亚伯拉罕还有长期购买彩票的习惯。

sentences.en: To prove it, he carried a garbage bag into court stuffed with tickets he had purchased over the years.
sentences.zh: 为了证明这一点，他带了一个垃圾袋到法庭，里面装满了多年来购买的彩票。

sentences.en: Michael was revealed to be a liar.
sentences.zh: 迈克尔被揭穿是个骗子。

sentences.en: In sworn testimony as part of the pre-trial discovery process,
sentences.zh: 在审前取证阶段的宣誓证词中，

sentences.en: Michael said he'd lent Abraham money in the past to help put food on his table.
sentences.zh: 迈克尔说他过去曾借钱给亚伯拉罕，帮他解决温饱。

sentences.en: But during the trial,
sentences.zh: 但在庭审期间，

sentences.en: Michael denied ever helping Abraham at all.
sentences.zh: 迈克尔否认曾给过亚伯拉罕任何帮助。

sentences.en: After five days of testimony and a little over an hour's deliberation, the jury unanimously agreed that Abraham Shakespeare did not steal the lottery tickets from Michael Ford.
sentences.zh: 经过五天的证词陈述和一小时多的审议，陪审团一致认为亚伯拉罕·莎士比亚没有从迈克尔·福特那里偷走彩票。

sentences.en: Michael was denied any of Abraham's winnings.
sentences.zh: 迈克尔没能分到亚伯拉罕的任何奖金。

sentences.en: Abraham's lawyer told the media,
sentences.zh: 亚伯拉罕的律师告诉媒体：

sentences.en: This lawsuit was about greed.
sentences.zh: “这场官司纯粹是出于贪婪。”

sentences.en: The plaintiff manufactured a story and a plan to try to take advantage of my client.
sentences.zh: “原告捏造了一个故事和计划，试图占我当事人的便宜。”

sentences.en: While Abraham felt Michael had scandalised his reputation, he ultimately forgave him.
sentences.zh: 虽然亚伯拉罕觉得迈克尔损害了他的名誉，但他最终还是原谅了他。

sentences.en: He didn't harbour any anger, saying,
sentences.zh: 他没有怀恨在心，说道：

sentences.en: That guy used to be a real good friend of mine.
sentences.zh: “那家伙曾经是我很好的朋友。”

sentences.en: If he only waited,
sentences.zh: “如果他能再等等，

sentences.en: I could have given him $250,000 easy.
sentences.zh: 我本来可以轻松给他25万美元的。”

sentences.en: Michael rejected the jury's findings and began a lengthy appeals process.
sentences.zh: 迈克尔拒绝接受陪审团的裁决，并开始了漫长的上诉程序。

sentences.en: The final hearing was scheduled for Wednesday, May 27, 2009, two and a half years after Abraham won the lottery.
sentences.zh: 最终听证会定于2009年5月27日星期三举行，距离亚伯拉罕中奖已经过去了两年半。

sentences.en: Michael Ford's appeal was ultimately dismissed, but Abraham Shakespeare wasn't around to hear the good news.
sentences.zh: 迈克尔·福特的上诉最终被驳回，但亚伯拉罕·莎士比亚已经不在人世，无法听到这个好消息了。

sentences.en: No one had seen Abraham in the weeks leading up to the hearing and calls to his cell phone were going unanswered.
sentences.zh: 在听证会前的几周里，没人见过亚伯拉罕，打他手机也无人接听。

sentences.en: Word spread that he'd skipped town to avoid the spotlight and get some much-needed reSt.
sentences.zh: 有传言说他为了躲避聚光灯并好好休息，已经离开了小镇。

sentences.en: Since his lottery win,
sentences.zh: 自从中奖以来，

sentences.en: Abraham had become a father for the second time.
sentences.zh: 亚伯拉罕第二次当了父亲。

sentences.en: He'd separated from the baby's mother shortly after the birth and the pair had been embroiled in hostile court proceedings ever since.
sentences.zh: 他在孩子出生后不久就与孩子的母亲分开了，此后两人一直陷入激烈的法律诉讼中。

sentences.en: There was gossip that the woman had intentionally become pregnant just to access Abraham's money.
sentences.zh: 有流言称那个女人是故意怀孕，就是为了得到亚伯拉罕的钱。

sentences.en: This fuelled a belief that he'd fled to avoid paying child support.
sentences.zh: 这加剧了人们认为他为了逃避抚养费而潜逃的猜测。

sentences.en: He also had an unpaid bill with the law firm that fought his civil suit.
sentences.zh: 他还拖欠了为他打民事官司的律师事务所的费用。

sentences.en: The rumour mill swung into overdrive.
sentences.zh: 谣言四起，愈演愈烈。

sentences.en: Some claimed Abraham was doing business or receiving medical treatment overseas.
sentences.zh: 有人声称亚伯拉罕在海外做生意或接受治疗。

sentences.en: Others accused him of being on the run from police.
sentences.zh: 还有人指责他在躲避警察的追捕。

sentences.en: Those who knew Abraham best denied these assertions.
sentences.zh: 最了解亚伯拉罕的人否认了这些说法。

sentences.en: There were even rumours that he'd died of AIDS, despite some alleged sightings of him around Lakeland.
sentences.zh: 甚至有传言说他死于艾滋病，尽管有人声称在莱克兰附近见过他。

sentences.en: Prior to winning the lottery,
sentences.zh: 在赢得彩票之前，

sentences.en: Abraham spent several days a week doing odd jobs at a barbershop owned by his long-time friend, Greg Smith.
sentences.zh: 亚伯拉罕每周有几天会在他老朋友格雷格·史密斯开的理发店里打零工。

sentences.en: Greg saw first-hand the overwhelmingly negative impact that the win had on Abraham.
sentences.zh: 格雷亲眼目睹了那次中奖给亚伯拉罕带来的巨大负面影响。

sentences.en: His sunny disposition faded and he often told Greg,
sentences.zh: 他开朗的性格消失了，经常对格雷说：

sentences.en: I wish I could go back to my old self.
sentences.zh: 我真希望自己能变回以前的样子。

sentences.en: Greg had been struggling to stay on top of his mortgage repayments, but he'd kept this from Abraham as he didn't want to be seen as another moocher.
sentences.zh: 格雷一直为偿还房贷而苦苦挣扎，但他对亚伯拉罕隐瞒了这一点，因为他不想被看作是另一个占便宜的人。

sentences.en: One day, Abraham spotted banking documents at Greg's barbershop.
sentences.zh: 一天，亚伯拉罕在格雷的理发店里发现了银行文件。

sentences.en: Realising his friend was in trouble, he paid off Greg's $63,000 mortgage.
sentences.zh: 意识到朋友有难，他帮格雷还清了63,000美元的房贷。

sentences.en: Greg agreed to give Abraham $500 a month until the debt was repaid.
sentences.zh: 格雷同意每月给亚伯拉罕500美元，直到还清这笔债。

sentences.en: When Abraham abruptly left Lakeland and stopped answering his phone,
sentences.zh: 当亚伯拉罕突然离开莱克兰并不再接听电话时，

sentences.en: Greg sent him a text message that read,
sentences.zh: 格雷给他发了一条短信，写道：

sentences.en: Call me, it's important.
sentences.zh: 给我回电话，这很重要。

sentences.en: Abraham messaged back,
sentences.zh: 亚伯拉罕回信说：

sentences.en: Bro, I'm on a cruise and I'll be back in town soon.
sentences.zh: 兄弟，我在游轮上，很快就会回城。

sentences.en: I just needed to get away because all these people are bothering me about money.
sentences.zh: 我只是需要离开一下，因为这些人一直在为钱的事烦我。

sentences.en: Greg told Abraham to call him immediately.
sentences.zh: 格雷让亚伯拉罕立即给他回电话。

sentences.en: Abraham replied,
sentences.zh: 亚伯拉罕回复道：

sentences.en: I'll call you in the morning.
sentences.zh: 我早上再打给你。

sentences.en: I'm just trying to get myself together.
sentences.zh: 我只是想让自己冷静一下。

sentences.en: Greg was struck by the exchange.
sentences.zh: 这次交流让格雷感到震惊。

sentences.en: Abraham's limited education meant he struggled to read and write.
sentences.zh: 亚伯拉罕受教育程度有限，读写都很困难。

sentences.en: He preferred calling or speaking with people face to face over communicating through text.
sentences.zh: 比起发短信，他更喜欢打电话或与人面对面交流。

sentences.en: Abraham's messages were also unusually formal.
sentences.zh: 亚伯拉罕的短信也异常正式。

sentences.en: They didn't reflect his usual speech and writing patterns.
sentences.zh: 这与他平时的说话和写作习惯完全不同。

sentences.en: Greg's wife agreed that the messages were odd.
sentences.zh: 格雷的妻子也认为这些短信很奇怪。

sentences.en: She sent Abraham a text asking him to come home.
sentences.zh: 她给亚伯拉罕发了一条短信，叫他回家。

sentences.en: He replied,
sentences.zh: 他回复道：

sentences.en: I'll be home soon and I'll call you when I get back.
sentences.zh: 我很快就会回家，回来后我会给你打电话。

sentences.en: Days passed, but Abraham didn't call.
sentences.zh: 几天过去了，亚伯拉罕却没有打电话。

sentences.en: Abraham was a doting father who typically called his elder son twice a week.
sentences.zh: 亚伯拉罕是一位慈爱的父亲，通常每周会给大儿子打两次电话。

sentences.en: These calls also stopped and were replaced by text messages.
sentences.zh: 这些电话也停止了，取而代之的是短信。

sentences.en: He sent one acquaintance upwards of 60 texts but still made no calls.
sentences.zh: 他给一位熟人发了60多条短信，但依然没有打过一个电话。

sentences.en: In his messages,
sentences.zh: 在短信中，

sentences.en: Abraham assured everyone that he was fine and okay.
sentences.zh: 亚伯拉罕向所有人保证他很好，没事。

sentences.en: During one exchange, he was uncharacteristically belligerent, referring to himself as a grown-ass man who would return to Lakeland when he was ready.
sentences.zh: 在一次交流中，他表现得异常好斗，称自己是一个成熟的男人，准备好时自然会回到莱克兰。

sentences.en: Increasingly suspicious, one of Abraham's associates texted a question that only he could answer.
sentences.zh: 越来越怀疑的亚伯拉罕的一位熟人发短信问了一个只有他本人才能回答的问题。

sentences.en: There was no response.
sentences.zh: 但没有收到回复。

sentences.en: A few people tried to report Abraham missing but were dismissed because they weren't family.
sentences.zh: 几个人试图报告亚伯拉罕失踪，但因为他们不是亲属而被拒绝了。

sentences.en: Abraham's mother, Elizabeth, considered doing so as Abraham wasn't the type to go away for long periods without getting in touch.
sentences.zh: 亚伯拉罕的母亲伊丽莎白考虑过报警，因为亚伯拉罕不是那种会长时间离开而不联系的人。

sentences.en: But one of her nephews,
sentences.zh: 但她的一个侄子，

sentences.en: Cedric Adam, said that Abraham was calling him daily.
sentences.zh: 塞德里克·亚当说，亚伯拉罕每天都在给他打电话。

sentences.en: He had also received a birthday card for Elizabeth from Abraham.
sentences.zh: 他还收到了亚伯拉罕寄给伊丽莎白的生日贺卡。

sentences.en: It contained $100 and a necklace along with a handwritten message that read,
sentences.zh: 里面有100美元和一条项链，还有一张手写的字条，写着：

sentences.en: I'll be home soon, followed by Abraham's signature.
sentences.zh: 我很快就会回家，后面还有亚伯拉罕的签名。

sentences.en: Elizabeth recognised her son's handwriting which temporarily quashed any niggling concerns.
sentences.zh: 伊丽莎白认出了儿子的笔迹，这暂时打消了她心中挥之不去的疑虑。

sentences.en: By November, seven months had passed since Abraham left Lakeland.
sentences.zh: 到了11月，亚伯拉罕离开莱克兰已经七个月了。

sentences.en: Thanksgiving was one of his favourite holidays.
sentences.zh: 感恩节是他最喜欢的节日之一。

sentences.en: When the day came and went without any word,
sentences.zh: 当这一天过去却依然没有任何消息时，

sentences.en: Abraham's prolonged silence became too loud to ignore.
sentences.zh: 亚伯拉罕长时间的沉默变得震耳欲聋，让人无法忽视。

sentences.en: Abraham Shakespeare was officially reported missing.
sentences.zh: 亚伯拉罕·莎士比亚被正式报告失踪。

sentences.en: Finding him wasn't going to be easy.
sentences.zh: 找到他并不容易。

sentences.en: Abraham was accustomed to living a transient lifestyle.
sentences.zh: 亚伯拉罕习惯了漂泊不定的生活方式。

sentences.en: At the time he left Lakeland,
sentences.zh: 在他离开莱克兰时，

sentences.en: Abraham was dating a woman named Courtney Daniels.
sentences.zh: 亚伯拉罕正在和一位名叫考特尼·丹尼尔斯的女性交往。

sentences.en: Courtney told police the last time she'd seen Abraham was the first week of April.
sentences.zh: 考特尼告诉警方，她最后一次见到亚伯拉罕是在四月的第一周。

sentences.en: He'd dropped her at a bus station so she could visit a friend interstate.
sentences.zh: 他把她送到车站，让她去探望外地的朋友。

sentences.en: That night, the couple spoke on the phone for hours, but after that,
sentences.zh: 那天晚上，两人在电话里聊了几个小时，但那之后，

sentences.en: Courtney never heard another word.
sentences.zh: 考特尼就再也没有收到过他的任何消息。

sentences.en: She soon learned of a rumour that Abraham had left Florida with another woman.
sentences.zh: 她很快听说了一个传言，说亚伯拉罕和另一个女人离开了佛罗里达。

sentences.en: When she returned to Abraham's house to pack up her things, all of his belongings were still there.
sentences.zh: 当她回到亚伯拉罕家收拾东西时，他所有的物品都还在那里。

sentences.en: After winning the lottery,
sentences.zh: 中奖后，

sentences.en: Abraham grew tired of all the paperwork and meetings related to his finances.
sentences.zh: 亚伯拉罕厌倦了所有与财务相关的文书工作和会议。

sentences.en: He'd sought help from a friend of 15 years,
sentences.zh: 他向一位相识15年的朋友寻求帮助，

sentences.en: Judy Hagans, who assumed the unofficial role of his assistant.
sentences.zh: 朱迪·哈根斯，她非正式地担任了他的助理。

sentences.en: Abraham eventually designated
sentences.zh: 亚伯拉罕最终指定

sentences.en: Judy as his power of attorney.
sentences.zh: 朱迪为他的授权代理人。

sentences.en: This meant she had control over all of his financial decisions and could handle his affairs whenever he went away.
sentences.zh: 这意味着她可以控制他所有的财务决策，并在他外出时处理他的事务。

sentences.en: Others viewed this decision as absurd.
sentences.zh: 其他人认为这个决定很荒谬。

sentences.en: Judy had no business or legal qualifications and was viewed by some as a party girl.
sentences.zh: 朱迪没有任何商业或法律资质，在一些人眼中她只是个爱玩的人。

sentences.en: Regardless,
sentences.zh: 无论如何，

sentences.en: Abraham signed the papers in early April of 2009,
sentences.zh: 亚伯拉罕在2009年4月初签署了文件，

sentences.en: shortly before he disappeared.
sentences.zh: 就在他失踪前不久。

sentences.en: Judy told police she hadn't seen him since.
sentences.zh: 朱迪告诉警方，从那以后她就没见过他。

sentences.en: Abraham had been scheduled to appear in court in August for a child support enforcement action but never showed up.
sentences.zh: 亚伯拉罕原定于8月出庭处理一起子女抚养费强制执行案件，但他从未露面。

sentences.en: His attorney,
sentences.zh: 他的律师，

sentences.en: Howard Stitzel, told the court that Abraham was out of the country receiving medical treatment for an undisclosed illness.
sentences.zh: 霍华德·斯蒂策尔告诉法庭，亚伯拉罕正在国外接受一种未公开疾病的治疗。

sentences.en: When questioned by police,
sentences.zh: 当被警方询问时，

sentences.en: Howard said the last time he'd spoken to Abraham on the phone was in October, almost six months since he'd last been seen in Florida.
sentences.zh: 霍华德说他最后一次与亚伯拉罕通电话是在10月，距离他最后一次在佛罗里达露面已经过去了近六个月。

sentences.en: He was reluctant to divulge the specifics due to attorney-client privilege but was absolutely certain it was Abraham he'd spoken to as he was familiar with his voice.
sentences.zh: 由于律师与客户的保密特权，他不愿透露具体细节，但他非常确定与他通话的就是亚伯拉罕，因为他很熟悉他的声音。

sentences.en: Abraham hadn't sounded distressed and there had been no follow-ups.
sentences.zh: 亚伯拉罕听起来并不痛苦，之后也没有任何后续联系。

sentences.en: Due to the conflicting rumours regarding his whereabouts, police weren't sure what to make of Abraham Shakespeare's disappearance.
sentences.zh: 由于关于他下落的传言相互矛盾，警方不确定该如何看待亚伯拉罕·莎士比亚的失踪。

sentences.en: They accepted the possibility that he was simply lying low to avoid the struggles he'd faced since winning the lottery.
sentences.zh: 他们接受了这样一种可能性：他只是为了躲避中奖后所面临的困境而隐姓埋名。

sentences.en: In public appeals, they indicated they'd leave Abraham be as long as he reached out to confirm he was okay.
sentences.zh: 在公开呼吁中，他们表示只要亚伯拉罕联系确认他平安无事，他们就不会打扰他。

sentences.en: Police also considered that Abraham might have met with foul play.
sentences.zh: 警方也考虑过亚伯拉罕可能遭遇了不测。

sentences.en: At the peak of his affluence,
sentences.zh: 在他最富有的时候，

sentences.en: Abraham had drawn a lot of ire.
sentences.zh: 亚伯拉罕招致了很多人的怨恨。

sentences.en: following his failed civil suit against Abraham,
sentences.zh: 在针对亚伯拉罕的民事诉讼失败后，

sentences.en: Michael Ford moved to Georgia where he resumed work as a truck driver.
sentences.zh: 迈克尔·福特搬到了佐治亚州，重新开始做卡车司机。

sentences.en: He admitted to police that he'd returned to Florida a couple of times but maintained it was only for work.
sentences.zh: 他向警方承认他曾几次回到佛罗里达，但坚称只是为了工作。

sentences.en: Michael said he hadn't seen Abraham since their court battle and he had no idea where he might have gone.
sentences.zh: 迈克尔说自从官司结束后他就没见过亚伯拉罕，也不知道他可能去了哪里。

sentences.en: An examination of Abraham's bank account revealed he'd made several withdrawals in the months leading up to his disappearance but none since.
sentences.zh: 对亚伯拉罕银行账户的检查显示，他在失踪前的几个月里曾多次取款，但之后再无动静。

sentences.en: The account also revealed a harsh reality.
sentences.zh: 账户也揭示了一个残酷的现实。

sentences.en: Within three years,
sentences.zh: 在三年内，

sentences.en: Abraham had spent, given away, or loaned almost all of his $17 million.
sentences.zh: 亚伯拉罕已经花掉、送出或借出了他1700万美元中的几乎全部。

sentences.en: Only $45,000 remained.
sentences.zh: 只剩下45,000美元。

sentences.en: While murder still couldn't be ruled out, it seemed highly unlikely that anyone would kill Abraham for such a small amount.
sentences.zh: 虽然不能排除谋杀的可能性，但为了这么点钱杀害亚伯拉罕似乎不太可能。

sentences.en: He also had no life insurance meaning no one stood to legally claim his remaining money upon his death.
sentences.zh: 他也没有人寿保险，这意味着在他死后，没有人能合法地索取他剩余的钱。

sentences.en: Detective David Wallace was part of a team fronting the search for Abraham Shakespeare.
sentences.zh: 大卫·华莱士警探是负责搜寻亚伯拉罕·莎士比亚团队的一员。

sentences.en: One day, he received a phone call from an anonymous male who asked for him specifically.
sentences.zh: 一天，他接到了一名匿名男子的电话，对方指名要找他。

sentences.en: When Detective Wallace asked who he was speaking to, the caller replied,
sentences.zh: 当华莱士警探询问对方是谁时，来电者回答：

sentences.en: It don't matter who this is.
sentences.zh: 我是谁不重要。

sentences.en: I'm down here in Miami and just want to let you know I saw Abraham Shakespeare in a damn strip club.
sentences.zh: 我在迈阿密，只是想让你知道，我在一家该死的脱衣舞俱乐部看到了亚伯拉罕·莎士比亚。

sentences.en: He reached in his pocket for something and his ID fell out and I saw it was him.
sentences.zh: 他伸手去口袋拿东西时身份证掉了出来，我看到那就是他。

sentences.en: Detective Wallace asked when, but the caller abruptly hung up.
sentences.zh: 华莱士警探询问是什么时候，但来电者突然挂断了电话。

sentences.en: The call puzzled
sentences.zh: 这通电话让

sentences.en: Detective Wallace.
sentences.zh: 华莱士警探感到困惑。

sentences.en: It wasn't traceable so he couldn't verify it.
sentences.zh: 电话无法追踪，所以他无法核实。

sentences.en: He was also aware that in high profile cases like Abraham's, pranksters often stirred up mischief for police.
